# dsh-sound-plugin
中文 | English
> Want to do something else while DeepSeek Harness works for you? Just install this plugin — it call
s you back with a system sound the moment it needs you.
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that plays a system sound when:

- the AI **finishes responding** (completion sound), and/or
- a **pending approval** or **user quest
ion** appears (approval reminder).
Each is an independent toggle in **Settings → General**.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Replace `<name>` with your profile name:
- **Desktop** app: `desktop` (quit the app first — its profile is managed exclusively by the Electro

n application).
- **Web** app: `web`.
- Or any custom name, e.g. `my-profile`.
Then restart DSH (or reload the profile) and open **Settings → General** to see the two toggles.
## What is a profile?
A **profile** is a named, independent environment with its own plugins and settings — like a browser
profile (each has its own extensions). Profiles live under `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>`.
Installing with `--profile <name>` adds the plugin to that environment only, so different profiles c
an hold different plugin sets without interfering.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0 <0.3.0` (developed and tested on `0.2.1-rc.3`).
- Sound playback uses a

system command:
- **Windows**: PowerShell (`System.Media.SoundPlayer`) — built in.
- **macOS**: `afp

lay` — built in.
- **Linux**: `paplay` (PulseAudio / PipeWire). Install `pulseaudio-utils` if `papla

n.
- **Linux**: `paplay` (PulseAudio / PipeWire). Install `pulseaudio-utils` if `paplay` is missing.
## How it works
- **Completion sound**: listens to `agent/status` and plays once after every agent (the main turn pl

us any subagents) has gone idle.
- **Approval reminder**: listens to the session event feed for `app

roval/asked` and `ask_user_question` tool calls.
- The "ding-dong" WAV is generated in memory (no bu
ndled audio file) and played through the default audio device.
